reviewed_decisions.source: ADR 0102 — The file-only evidence population reaches zero
reviewed_decisions.premise_review: Retain its direct-form filter-pipeline and DecodeParms-array tests as good evidence for ordering and per-stage parameter association. That accepted test work does not exercise §7.3.10's direct/indirect equivalence, so indirect ordinary-stream forms are a separate coverage slice rather than a reason to reopen the cascade behavior.
reviewed_decisions.result: No contrary premise; one focused indirect-form draft supplied.

reviewed_decisions.source: ADR 0036 — The last filter, and the family around it
reviewed_decisions.premise_review: Its LZW review and corpus pipeline examples establish codec decoding and chain order. The inspected LZW EarlyChange assertions use direct parameter dictionaries; they do not establish reference resolution for a whole DecodeParms value or array entry.
reviewed_decisions.result: Retain algorithm evidence; treat indirect parameter representation as an uncovered representation control.

reviewed_decisions.premise_review: These effective edits make a specific directness exception for cross-reference stream dictionary values and, for encoded xref streams, Filter/DecodeParms. Since these fields are consumed before general object resolution exists, xref streams must stay out of positive examples for ordinary streams.
reviewed_decisions.result: No exception leak: xref::decode_direct reads only directly stated values, while ordinary stream consumers use get_key/resolve. The directness rule also constrains writers; no invalid-reader refusal defect is claimed.

conclusion: §7.3.10, not §7.3.9, is the generic direct/indirect equivalence source. §7.3.9 remains the separate null and undefined-reference rule. Source semantics and implementation appear aligned in inspected ordinary stream paths; assertions currently prove direct forms, and the two scratch drafts add exact-xref indirect positives.
parent_followup: Retain ADR0102 ordering/per-stage evidence, but its direct parameters do not establish scalar indirect equivalence. NewB54 qualifies the initially clean outer-layer assessment; no historicalADRrewrite.
